title: Controller Utility Value
summary: Recent balance direction continues to reward coordinated smoke timing and post-plant denial utility.
recommendation: Players comfortable on Brimstone, Omen, and Viper gain value when the comp needs structure.

title: Initiator Info Economy
summary: Information-gathering utility remains central for teams that want safer map control before committing.
recommendation: Sova-style information play is especially useful on maps with contested mid space.

title: Entry Pressure Still Wins
summary: Aggressive duelists still convert high value when their utility is paired with disciplined follow-up.
recommendation: Jett and Raze specialists remain strong recommendations for fast-hit or space-taking plans.
